label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Sale of Goods Directive ((EU) 2019/771) - Article 10: Liability of the seller
5. Notwithstanding paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, Member States may maintain or introduce only a limitation period for the remedies provided for in Article 13. Member States shall ensure that such limitation period allows the consumer to exercise the remedies laid down in Article 13 for any lack of conformity for which the seller is liable pursuant to paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, and which becomes apparent during the period of time referred to in those paragraphs.
raw_output: When a customer returns a faulty product, the seller must allow enough time for the customer to claim a refund or replacement, as the law lets them fix the issue if the problem is discovered within a reasonable period. This applies to any business selling goods to consumers.
enrichment: When a customer returns a faulty product, the seller must allow enough time for the customer to claim a refund or replacement, as the law lets them fix the issue if the problem is discovered within a reasonable period. This applies to any business selling goods to consumers.
